turn.user_message: Where on the ward does each change happen?
turn.context: Prompt 1 of bm-pr-01. bed-management.md §7.4.2: the 24-hour signal, the 5 PM round, OPD prescriptions as intake, stage times and the desk link, the bill-close and bill-open join, the 1 PM ICU signal. The drawing comes from the approved Processes landing page B, the trial ward.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Processes, turn 2 (the record stops at 31)

text: Six small changes, each in a room you already have. None of them is a new job.
bullets: On the round, the doctor checks a date instead of giving one. That is the change people will feel most.
At the desk, patients are called in for a time. At billing, one report is added.
The other three are a time written down, in OPD, at the ICU and at the 5 PM round.
chat.invite: Next, we can see why your patients still get in so late.

blocks.title: Six pins on one ward
blocks.deck: Your trial ward seen from above. Each change is pinned in the room where it happens.

blocks.plan_label: A ward drawn as an example. Every ward in your hospital has these rooms.
blocks.rule: Each change is a time, or a thing written down, inside work people already do. Nobody gets a new job.

sheets.title: Date checked on the round
sheets.text: The doctor sees a likely date for each patient, a day ahead, and confirms or changes it by voice.
sheets.entry: Do doctors mention discharge dates on rounds today?

sheets.title: The 5 PM round
sheets.text: One fixed round of the beds likely to free tomorrow. It is what lets the plan freeze at 6 PM.
sheets.entry: Who could do this round on your wards?

sheets.title: Admissions written down in OPD
sheets.text: When a doctor advises admission, the date, the procedure and the likely stay are written down once.
sheets.entry: How are planned admissions booked today?

sheets.title: Patients called in on time
sheets.text: The desk calls each patient for the time their bed will be free. It also confirms dates back into the plan.

sheets.title: Bill close and open joined
sheets.text: One report puts the last bill of one patient and the first bill of the next on the same bed.

sheets.title: Step-down named by 1 PM
sheets.text: ICU patients likely to move to a ward are named by 1 PM, in time for the 2 PM plan.

lines.value: Decided when a bed is found
